about: Extensions that ship with Sidefolk (DECISIONS D39, D55, docs/research/extensions-catalog.md). Each is a small program built with the app (extensions/<folder>/Sources), installed with it and updated with it; "on" says whether it starts switched on. The others are in the add-on gallery (github.com/ghassenbrg/sidefolk-addons). hello-folk is a sample for developers and doesn't ship.
